t: Delivers clean, straight cuts in non-abrasive soft materials such as cardboard, polystyrene, carpet, leather and rubber. Symmetrical, sharp-ground serrated knife edge cuts most soft materials effectively. High carbon steel blade (152mm) cuts pliable materials of up to 100mm thickness. Requires less physical effort than common handheld knives. For use with jigsaws with T-shank clamping systems.
